import subprocess,sys,json
p=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-c','import time\nend=time.process_time()+0.1\nwhile time.process_time()<end: pass\ntime.sleep(60)'])

proc_group_sampling.cpu_scope: sum of maximum observed SELF ticks for distinct PID/start-time identities, never child ticks; a sampling lower bound, not complete accounting
proc_group_sampling.memory_scope: sum RSS can double-count shared pages and miss between-sample peaks; it is not physical memory usage or a group peak. Per-process VmHWM values are not summed.
proc_group_sampling.coverage_scope: only members discovered from owned process descendants and verified to retain this new group/session; short-lived, unseen orphaned or escaped descendants can be missed. Final records retain last actual observations after exit; no zero or synthetic completion is substituted.

rss_scope: maximum reported for the waited child family; not total cgroup peak
